title: OpenEpi reference output
description: Labelled numbers captured by fixtures/openepi/capture.mjs from the live OpenEpi site (v1.0 spec §9). Produced by the openepi workflow on demand/monthly, never hand-edited. `statistic` is the labels.json mapping: a calc.<id>.<path> key or null (shown but not compared). `decimals` counts the decimals OpenEpi displayed; the comparison rule is |engine - value| <= 0.5 x 10^-decimals.

value.description: Displayed number, or the displayed text itself for bound/not-available displays such as '<0.0000001' — those always carry statistic null.

decimals.description: Decimals in the displayed text before parsing; may be negative when a person-time rate is restated to a coarser per-unit scale (0.5 x 10^-decimals stays the tolerance).
